inlines.v: REPLEN'ISH, verb transitive [Latin re and plenus, full.] 1. To fill; to stock with numbers or abundance. The magazines are replenished with corn. The springs are replenished with water. Multiply and replenish the earth. Genesis 1:28. 2. To finish; to complete. [Not in use.] REPLEN'ISH, verb intransitive To recover former fullness.
